name: security

findings.message: _ENGINE_OWNED_NS_RE is a new hardcoded enumeration of 21 engine-owned namespace prefixes; a new engine namespace added without updating this regex lets a plugin claim events in it undetected by SPEC-2, the symmetric risk to the _PLUGIN_NS_RE this change removes.

The ADR-001 exception pattern is built from `basename "$_1951_pd"` with only hyphen-to-underscore substitution, so a plugin directory name containing bash glob metacharacters ([ ] * ?) survives into the right-hand side of the [[ == ]] test and is interpreted as a wildcard, potentially exempting unrelated engine-namespace events from the SPEC-2 check.

The SPEC-1 namespace-extraction loop calls eb_manifest_events without pre-filtering through eb_manifest_events_invalid_v; a single-component event name (no dot) in a manifest passes the awk parser, and ${_1951_pev%.*} returns it unchanged, polluting the plugin-namespace set with an incorrect prefix that could falsely flag engine events.

reason: the security lens found no high or critical problem the change introduced that fails it
